classification.difficultyReason: Combine an explicit negative fractional power with reciprocal conversion; both transformations define the requested final form.

content.prompt: Simplify the following, expressing your answer with positive exponents. $\left(\dfrac{8a^3}{b^3}\right)^{-\frac13}$

answer.short:
$\dfrac{b}{2a}$, $a\ne0$, $b\ne0$.

Take the cube root, then its reciprocal.
answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\left(\frac{8a^3}{b^3}\right)^{-\frac13}&=\left(\frac{2a}{b}\right)^{-1}\\\left(\frac{8a^3}{b^3}\right)^{-\frac13}&=\frac{b}{2a}\end{align*}$$The original denominator requires $b\ne0$, and the negative outer power also requires $a\ne0$.
